T16370:C1.why: Needs the owner's DNS records and custom domains (staging.reelballers.com, api-staging.reelballers.com) to exist, and WebKit, whose system libraries are absent from the worker and staging-check containers. After those are in place run e2e/checks/T16370.check.spec.js (WebKit, iPhone 14) against staging: the T16370:C1 test signs in from inside the page, reloads, and reopens a context from the saved cookies.

T16370:C2.why: Same prerequisites as C1. The T16370:C2 test in e2e/checks/T16370.check.spec.js opens an active game in Annotate in WebKit (iPhone 14) on staging, taps Play and waits for the video's time to advance.

T16370:C3.command: cd src/backend && python3 -m pytest tests/test_t16370_staging_own_domain.py -q -p no:cacheprovider
